description: Drop-in Python library plus two example sensors that expose a hierarchical registry of named, typed, runtime-mutable variables (doubles/booleans/integers/enums) for live monitoring and tuning. Inspired by IHMC YoVariables. Bundles the variable-tools-scope web app for browser-based plotting + scrubbing + tuning. The :demo sensor runs a fake control loop populating a registry; the :scope sensor takes other resources as deps and fans out via DoCommand to merge their registries into a single flat reading map suitable for data-manager capture.

models.short_description: Sensor with a fake control loop demonstrating the variable_tools library end-to-end.
Merges variable_tools registries from declared resource deps into a single flat reading map.
